known_limitations: Legacy config pollution (BaseModel.__init__, outside Gate 4 paths): loading a checkpoint writes its train settings into the global mainConfig.train, and a later load in the same process takes them as CLI changes (for example scale_conditioning=True from a previous conditioned checkpoint makes an unconditioned checkpoint fail the strict load). predict is unaffected (one model per Dask worker); the benchmark restores mainConfig around every evaluation (benchmarks.common.isolated_main_config). Worth a fix in a gate that owns networks/baseModel.py.

calibrate_thresholds returns threshold None (fallback) when the best F-beta is 0 (no threshold finds a true particle), besides the min_particles rule; otherwise the tie rule would store 0.95 for an untrained class.

Per-class threshold calibration in training/run.py reads calibration_beta/min_particles/cross_class_nms from mainConfig.infer (entry point, the infer section of the same config); validation tomograms use the apix_native recorded in chunk_layout.json, no contrast inversion, no masks.
skip_inference for v2 needs `weights` (for the class table) and runs in the main process (no Dask). Without weights the maps are treated as v1.
Hann weights of the v2 accumulator are clamped at 1e-2 (float16 safety), so v2 border blending differs slightly from TorchIO's GridAggregator; v1 still uses GridAggregator unchanged.
v2 class maps are resampled back to native with the checkpoint's scale.resample and clamped to [0, 1] (Fourier ringing).

Arm (d) of the benchmarks: the public model is used only with --pretrained / $TOMOCPT_ZENODO_CKPT in a full run; a tiny run (feature_size 12) always warm-starts from arm (a)'s first v1 model, recorded under warm_start in report.json.
TomoCPT training is not seeded; benchmark seeds label repeated runs (synthetic data are seeded).
notes_for_next_agent: Gate 5: predict/calibration do not touch SSL; training/run.py only adds _calibrate_best_checkpoint after trainer.fit for mode == picking and data_pipeline_version == 2 on global rank 0 (errors logged, never raised). Inference entry points: tomocpt.predict.multiclass.predict_class_maps(model, tomo, infer_cfg, device, classes) -> ({row: native map}, apix_native) and peaks_from_class_maps(...); model must come from InferenceModel.load_from_checkpoint (strict). infer_tomos dispatches on model.is_pipeline_v2(). The v2 predict path calls model.predict_step(x, 0, apix=level.apix_work) for every level, so a network that wraps or replaces MySwinUNETR must keep forward(x, apix=None) -> (logits, hidden4). Calibration is stored under the top-level checkpoint key 'tomocpt_calibration' ({version 1, beta, grid, classes {number: {threshold|None, fbeta, n_true}}, val_tomograms}); Lightning ignores unknown top-level keys, so strict loads still work. Beware the mainConfig pollution limitation when loading several checkpoints in one process (see known_limitations). infer.length is now Optional (None default).
